claire_mktg: Quick ask Need verified numbers for two bullets in the launch post: per-token cost delta (quant vs fp16) and p95 coldstart for single-request UX. Keep payloads <=128 tokens. Can runtime run a tiny spotprobe and hand off a reproducible bundle?

eric_runtime: Yep. We'll measure batch=1, concurrency=1 in us-west1 hosted. Report p50/p95 latencies, token-cost per 1k tokens, and include CSV + small repro tar. ETA: 6 hours.

mina_bench: Running now. Local reproduce snippet we'll give:
```bash
docker run --rm -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY -v $(pwd)/payloads:/app/payloads redwood/bench:stable /app/run.sh --model rwd-gen4-small-quant --endpoint http://localhost:8080/v1/generate --payloads /app/payloads/mini.json --warmup 20 --duration 30 --concurrency 1
```

benchbot: benchmark job 1818000015 queued (tags: launch, marketing).

ops-bot: note: hosted autoscaler can affect first-request numbers. Recommend including a one-line caveat.

mina_bench: Uploaded artifacts s3://bench-outputs/marketing/1818000015/ (contains csv, traces, payloads, README). bench_artifact_id: 1818000015. Caveat: "Measured with single-request settings (batch=1, concurrency=1) in us-west1; real results may vary by workload and deployment mode."

claire_mktg: Awesome, thanks. Please flag any outlier trace ids if you see spikes so we can decide whether to call them out.

eric_runtime: Will do; will post trace ids if any notable spikes.
